name: dos_c_early
about: the C libraries of the DOS compilers of 1982-1985 (Microsoft C 1.0-3.0, Lattice, XENIX C's DOS library): K&R stdio over DOS handles, a printf of its own, malloc between the data and the stack, _main cutting the command line

notes._main: the command line was cut into words at spaces alone (no quotes); the C library of today cuts it its own way
notes.fopen: the old library had no text mode: every file is opened binary ("rb", "wb")
notes.kbdchar: DOS's buffered line input (function 0Ah): the line, a carriage return, a line feed; at the end of the input -1
notes.corein: the memory above the program's 64K: here pages of a block of the heap of as many pages as coremax says
notes.getdrive: the current drive (0 = A:); on a system without drives, C:
